## Context

Release work item for Goal #57. Implementation PR #56 is merged and the remaining work is exact-commit certification before the single production deployment.

## Expected outcome

The exact main commit is proven clean, fully tested, immutable and ready for the Goal-owned production deployment.

## Scope

- Confirm main contains the consolidated change
- Run and record the complete QA gate
- Confirm release version 0.1.0 and clean repository state

## Out of scope

- Performing the production mutation before the Goal completes
- Unrelated code changes

## Acceptance criteria

- main resolves to aa819d909a22bb98f9a9deeb1869eea7c5c2f5f3
- 395 tests pass with 100% coverage
- Credo, specs, formatting, Dialyzer and Hex audit pass
- Repository is clean and v0.1.0 is the declared version
